characters.name: Noor
characters.design: Warm ochre skin, short dark bob, oversized teal jacket, charcoal trousers, cream sneakers with yellow laces, small copper shoulder bag. A competent but distracted teenager; no adult glamour styling. Bare face, no glasses or additional accessories.

characters.name: Rami
characters.design: Warm brown skin, short curly hair, lavender hoodie, navy trousers, cream sneakers. Shy paper-spacecraft maker; same height as Noor, broader hair silhouette. Bare face, no glasses or new accessories.

characters.name: Noor's shadow
characters.design: Noor's exact silhouette, midnight ink, thin lavender edge visible in dark scenes. Can detach, gesture and travel along surfaces; never gains new clothes or a face identical to a new human.

characters.name: Aya
characters.design: Warm brown skin, long dark braid, mustard cardigan; carries folded paper planets.

characters.name: Zain
characters.design: Brown hair, navy overshirt over cream T-shirt; carries paper planets.

world.setting: A school arts corridor and classroom after sunset
rules: One independent shadow belongs to Noor; its motive is care, not punishment.
Paper rockets obey thrown arcs; no free-floating decoration.
The birthday happened the same evening; the old invitation was ignored, not magically erased.

episode1.state: 88.83s Arabic animated draft rendered and visually inspected 2026-10-15; listening and user approval pending.
episode1.outcome: Noor responds to the invitation she ignored, joins Rami to fold rockets, and invites Aya and Zain. Rami blows out the candle; Noor chooses the gathering over filming. Her shadow returns. A second shadow steals cake.
episode1.props: White folded rocket with blue planet and candle drawing; cake candle remains extinguished after wish.
